findings.finding: The future replay boundary does not bind cycle-driving preprocess/work values to the frozen row payload
findings.evidence: validate_frozen_record accepts a manually constructed task-0 record with the exact task ID, coordinate, row, row_count and canonical M1016 common receipt but shared preprocess changed to 0 and work_cycles changed to candidate=0, strongest_zero=999999 and same_coordinate_bit=999999. A second independent counterexample builds task 0 from the real frozen masks and from caller-supplied all-zero masks: both records validate and produce identical FrozenCoverage service counters/digest state, while preprocess changes 210->146 and work changes candidate 1664->0 and both baselines 4392->0. FrozenTaskRecord carries no masks or frozen-row provenance, and replay_frozen_sample accepts caller-supplied records.
findings.impact: A future wrapper can retain the exact 812160 task IDs, ten commits, canonical service counts and digest while substituting arbitrary preprocess/work values, thereby manufacturing candidate/baseline cycles and speedup without replaying the frozen 51.84M rows. The sealed contract's prose requiring iter_frozen_task_records is not an executable source invariant.

required_additive_repair: Remove caller-supplied FrozenTaskRecord sequences from the production replay boundary. A sanctioned sample/full entry must accept only an internally checked sample index (or no arguments) and read the frozen row file itself after exact identity validation.
At the point that cycles are consumed, rederive masks, shared preprocess and all three design work values from the frozen row bytes and M1016; do not trust dataclass fields supplied by a caller.
Extend the coverage digest to bind task coordinate, exact row payload (or its canonical digest), shared preprocess and the three work-cycle values, not only common service receipts.

Add the manual work/preprocess forgery and real-row-versus-zero-mask invariant-digest counterexamples as directed regressions, then request a different-author hammer before any M1066 full execution release.
